disqualifier.note: Independent goal-packet policy pins. This generator always writes both true; Goals Bootstrap defaults each independently and Migration can set both false; lint only reads reflectionRequired.
Yeet gate requirements plus a grandfather exemption overlay. Goals Migration writes grandfathered true while leaving requiresPullRequest and requiresMergeable true, so the bits are not exclusive.

evidence.note: The only producer sets commitsOnlySanitizedMarkdown true and both tracking flags false in the same object.
commitsOnlySanitizedMarkdown implies !trackedRawFindingContent and !codexPatchTextTracked; raw report bodies are written as separate untracked PacketDocuments.

notes: Sanitized-only versus which extra capture kinds are git-tracked. commitsOnlySanitizedMarkdown is the none-of-tracking case.

disqualifier.note: Independent npm package.json fields composed onto one manifest: private comes from baseManifestFor and sideEffects is a bundler hint. Regular package manifests keep sideEffects as an array, not a sibling boolean.
